title: Placencia marine polygons
description: Marine polygons for the Placencia site — 89 features. Sourced from `Pl Marine.shp` (legacy variant; `id` field, non-contiguous values 0..173). Per the 2026-05-12 polygon-ID audit, this is the polygon set that matches the published NBS / clade CSVs at 98% (87/89 join by Polygon_ID → id). The sibling `Pl Marine_ID.shp` renumbers identically-shaped geometry as MIMES_ID 1..89 contiguous and only matches the CSVs at 56% — so it is the canonical scheme for NEW MIMES outputs but unusable for the legacy NBS/clade tables until those are regenerated.
